short: Short version. The third reviewer (Runar, GitHub rbjarnason-positron) left one summary and eight inline comments on PR 4557 at head c5d44bd86f on 2026-10-06, and found nothing blocking. All eight points hold against the code, and every proposed reply below accepts the point and names the exact edit. Nothing is applied or posted yet, and jhan decides.
scope:
The edits are: one benchmark row to measure and commit, two small asserts to add (a bounds check and an alignment check, one compare each per row operation), one constant and two template clauses to drop, one unused accessor to drop, nine comment passages to rewrite or drop (six in v_vnni.hpp, two in kv_cache.hpp, one in t_llama_unit.cpp), PR-description edits in four items (R1 Status times, R2+R3 instruction comparison, R5 line 64, R7 lines 43-47 plus two new bullets), and two tracking issues to file: one for the view.hpp alignment TODO (R3) and one for the four DMA templates (R8, after the maintainer's sign-off). Nothing is applied or posted yet. jhan decides.

The review (GitHub review 5432936425, state COMMENTED, 2026-10-06 18:29 UTC) is on head c5d44bd86f. Every line number on this page is at that commit unless a sentence says otherwise. Each section ends with where the same lines sit on d9e7645fee, the PR head since the fast-forward push of 2026-10-07. The eight inline comments are R1 to R8 below. The summary is answered in section 3.
state_bullets: The PR branch jhan-kv-typed-tensors is one commit (c5d44bd86f) on top of main dd6e85226b. GitHub shows it MERGEABLE, blocked on review. The reviewed history is on jhan-kv-typed-tensors-pre-squash-20261006 (tip 1bdd592ff2).

The second reviewer (Wade) approved on 2026-10-06 17:05 UTC with one style nit: value-suffixed constant names such as V_PAIR_TOKENS_2 do not belong in shared files. jhan's answer is commit d9e7645fee. It was first pushed on the side branch jhan-kv-typed-tensors-plain-names. On 2026-10-07 00:3x UTC the PR branch was fast-forwarded onto it and pushed, so the PR head is now d9e7645fee. The line numbers on this page stay at c5d44bd86f, the commit the review was written against. It changes four files (v_vnni.hpp, amx_attn.cpp, t_heap_v2.cpp, t_llama_unit.cpp), spelling only, and the disassembly of libtron.a (the built tron library) is identical before and after. In v_vnni.hpp the six header constants (lines 67-86, 20 lines) are gone. Head lines 87 to 154 move up by 20 lines. Two comment lines are added before v_vnni_tensor, so head lines 155 to 238 move up by 18 lines. Three comment lines are added above append_v_row, so head lines from 239 on move up by 15 lines. kv_cache.hpp and memory.hpp are untouched there.

The maintainer (Ben) has not posted a review since 2026-09-29 (CHANGES_REQUESTED, six threads answered and applied on 2026-10-01). He has not explicitly signed off on the tagged operator new[] approach (commit 39a6899446: the DMA memory for KV blocks comes from a wrapper function named operator new[], so that the C++ rules treat the blocks as created objects). R8 and one open question of R5 depend on him.

delphi-3bda (the Intel test machine with AMX, Intel's matrix-multiply instruction set) is serving production on both sockets right now. The nightly CI (continuous integration, the automated test jobs) holds it from about 03:30 to 11:30 UTC. The R1 benchmark is a whole-machine measurement. It needs a free window and jhan's approval.
Requested reviewers on GitHub: axch, mcherba, BillBaumann, bgamari-positron.
order: Code and comment edits on top of d9e7645fee, in one commit: R2 (restore the bounds assert in pair_base, rewrite its comment, reword line 237 (219 on d9e7645fee)), R3 (alignment assert in v_source_row and v_destination_row, include common/memory.hpp), R4 (drop the width constant, both requires clauses and the comment), R5 (drop the writable at(), rewrite both Notes, turn the probe into STATIC_REQUIRE_FALSE), R6 (name book::fill_random as the exception in kv_cache.hpp:2248).

Build and test on delphi-3bda in both trees (AMX kernels compiled in and out): t_llama_unit, t_amx_numerics, t_amx_dispatch_dtype, t_heterogeneous_scheduler, make lint-notes. Re-run the objdump comparison of the wrapper functions, so the PR description can state the two new compare-and-branch instructions per row operation with a count.
R1: run bin/slice bench --update t_llama_unit on delphi-3bda in a free window (serving stopped, both sockets), commit the refreshed granite_rapids_6962p row as its own commit.

PR description: R7 (the two maintainer PRs merged into this branch, the scaled_v_expr addressing rewrite and the fill_storage_slot cast removal as changes of this PR, the four row aliases in the v_vnni.hpp bullet, the objdump evidence), R2 and R3 (lines 102, 103 and 105: the moved bodies differ from main by one compare-and-branch per pair_base call, the set_v/get_v wrappers by one alignment compare, and the count from the re-run), R5 (line 64: at() reads), R1 (the measured times).
Post the eight replies and the summary comment as soon as jhan approves them. They are written as plans ("I will").
Push the PR branch (d9e7645fee plus the edits above). Re-request the third reviewer. Add one follow-up line per thread that names the commit, and the measured 1/2/4-slice times in the R1 thread.
File the R3 Tech Debt issue for the view.hpp:13 TODO (timing open: with the push, or grouped with the R8 issue). R8's Note sentence and tracking issue wait for the maintainer's sign-off.

Optional, jhan decides: re-run the token identity (the check that the PR head and main produce the same generated tokens) and the performance A/B (the throughput comparison against main) on the new head. Two asserts now sit on the row paths. The 2026-10-06 token identity covers the current head only.
summary_quote:
This introduces a typed owner and view for the VNNI packed V plane, names the row-major native K plane at the kernel boundary, and routes the KV book's DMA allocation through an `operator new[]` so the `kv_block` objects actually come into existence. The direction is right, the layout move is faithful, and the evidence behind it does real work: token identity on delphi-3bda, the A/B band, and the per-function instruction comparison. I found nothing blocking and nothing that changes the shape of the code.

What is left is almost entirely comments that claim more than the code proves, plus one repository rule:

- The one concrete ask: refresh `config/test-benchmarks.json` for `t_llama_unit` (t/t_llama_unit.cpp:3461). Stated rule, cheap to satisfy, no CI consequence.
- Three comments in `h/tron/tensor/v_vnni.hpp` describe this refactor rather than the system it leaves behind (lines 57, 74, 190), and the one invariant the new row views assert, the `aligned` flag, lives only in prose (line 209).
- Two Notes disagree on who may take the packed plane address (h/tron/models/kv_cache.hpp:2248).
- The description credits two maintainer PRs in a way that reads as "already upstream" for work that is in this diff, including the `scaled_v_expr` tile-addressing rewrite (h/tron/models/kv_cache.hpp:2190).
- One deferrable pointer on the new Note in `h/system/memory.hpp` (line 197).

I have not repeated the points [the second reviewer] and [the maintainer] already raised.
summary_reply:
Thank you for the review. All eight points hold, and each thread has its reply.

Code: pair_base gets its bounds assert back, and v_source_row and v_destination_row assert 64-byte alignment. Each costs one compare-and-branch per call. The width constant and its two requires clauses are removed. The writable at() is removed. Nothing writes through it.

Comments: the v_vnni.hpp comments at lines 57, 74, 113, 190, 209 and 237, the two kv_cache.hpp Note passages (2242 and 2248) and the test comment at t_llama_unit.cpp:400 are rewritten or dropped to describe the code as it stands. The view.hpp alignment TODO gets a tracking issue.

Description: the two maintainer PRs are described as merged into this branch. The scaled_v_expr addressing rewrite and the fill_storage_slot cast removal are described as changes of this PR, with the objdump (disassembler) evidence.

Benchmark: I will run bin/slice bench --update t_llama_unit on delphi-3bda (the Intel test machine) in the next free window and commit the row.

The memory.hpp sentence and its tracking issue wait for the maintainer's sign-off on the operator new[] approach.
gaps: No edit from this page is applied. The word "will" in a reply is a plan, not a done step.
No timing of the two new t_llama_unit cases exists. The R1 reply says so. The benchmark row is measured only after jhan frees delphi-3bda.

The two asserts (R2, R3) change the instruction sequence of the row paths against main by one compare-and-branch each. No run with them exists. The PR description's A/B band (the 2026-09-22 throughput comparison against main) and token identity (the 2026-10-06 run with identical output tokens) do not cover them.
The R5 edit moves the public surface away from the maintainer's API sketch, which had a writable at(). The reply says so and offers to restore it. Ben has not been asked.

The R8 issue is drafted (title and body outline in the R8 section) but not filed. It waits for the maintainer's decision on the operator new[] wrapper. The R3 issue (view.hpp alignment TODO, all ten headers that build aligned views) has no draft yet.
The proposed replacement texts (comments, PR body passages) were not compiled or rendered. Line widths were checked against the 88-column limit only where a section says so.
